messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@cloudbridge.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Jun 3, 2025 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: DataSummit SF - partner opportunity (webinar + shared booth)

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — I run partner marketing at CloudBridge. We’re putting together a co-marketing package for DataSummit SF (Sept 22-24) and immediately thought of Redwood as a keynote partner for a joint webinar + shared booth. Quick highlights:

- Joint 45-minute webinar (30 min demo + 15 min Q&A) the week of Sept 15 (pre-conference)
- Shared 10x20 booth on the expo floor (split staffing and lead capture)
- MDF available to cover email sends, paid social, and booth collateral

Attached is the partner brief with rough audience numbers and the event floor plan. Would Redwood be open to a 50/50 marketing split or $15k MDF?

If this sounds interesting, could we schedule a 30-minute sync this week to align on speakers, budget, and timing?

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Partnerships, CloudBridge
attachments: DataSummit_Partner_Brief.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Jun 3, 2025 at 11:25 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: DataSummit SF - partner opportunity (webinar + shared booth)

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the brief. This is definitely interesting and a good fit for our field strategy. A few quick thoughts and requests so we can get internal buy-in:

1) Webinar: propose title "Scaling LLM Inference for Production" — Redwood to run a 20-min runtime demo, CloudBridge to cover integration/infra story, then joint Q&A. Camila to moderate.
2) Speakers: I can invite one customer (short case) and Vivek (SE) to handle technical Q&A. Please confirm who from CloudBridge will present the integration piece.
3) MDF / Budget: $15k sounds like a reasonable ask. Please confirm whether that’s a reimbursement or advance credit, and a simple term sheet if you have one.
4) Booth: we prefer a 60/40 split of booth costs in Redwood’s favor for staffing headcount (we’ll cover more on onsite staff). Can you share a quote for booth build & power?
5) Lead handling: propose real-time lead pass via CSV + HubSpot push; CloudBridge OK with sharing lead contact name/email? We’ll need a brief MOU for lead handling and privacy.

Can we do a 30-min call Thursday 6/5 at 10am PT to confirm speakers and the MDF terms? I’m copying Laura (Field Marketing) who will approve budget and Stephanie (marketing ops) for the email plan.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice@cloudbridge.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: EventOps <events@datasummit.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 5, 2025 at 8:47 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: DataSummit SF - partner opportunity (webinar + shared booth)

Camila — great, thanks for the quick feedback. Confirming a few items before our call (and see attached MDF term sheet v2):

- MDF: CloudBridge can provide an upfront $15,000 credit that will be applied to joint program invoices. We will require a signed term sheet (attached) and co-branded campaign plan within 30 days.
- Booth cost split: CloudBridge proposes 60/40 in your favor for booth staffing costs (Redwood 60%). We’ll cover 60% of booth build costs.
- Lead sharing: Ok to share lead name/email (real-time via HubSpot API preferred). We’ll include a data-processing addendum in the term sheet.
- Demo: Vivek confirmed availability for Sept 15 rehearsal and Sept 22 onsite.

Attaching MDF_Term_Sheet_CloudBridge_v2.pdf and a preliminary booth quote.

See you on the Thu 10am PT call — invite sent.

Best,
Alice Chen
CloudBridge Partnerships
